question: Should this PR require redacted live Cloudflare Sandbox proof before merge, or should maintainers accept the reporter-sample risk?
rationale: The code path is source-proven and the patch is narrow, but external contributor PR policy requires real behavior proof unless a maintainer intentionally accepts the platform-sample risk.

options.title: Require Live Cloudflare Proof
options.body: Ask for redacted Cloudflare Sandbox terminal output or logs showing `/proc/1/cgroup` and the patched detector classifying the runtime as containerized before merge.

options.title: Accept Reporter-Sample Risk
options.body: Maintainership can intentionally land based on the reporter cgroup sample and unit tests, while owning the risk that real Cloudflare variants differ.

options.title: Pause For Detector Consolidation
options.body: Pause this PR if owners want to remove the duplicated Bonjour detector before adding another platform signal.

recommendation.title: Require Live Cloudflare Proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted Cloudflare Sandbox terminal output or logs showing `/proc/1/cgroup` and the patched detector classifying the runtime as containerized before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the closest detector precedent and adjacent bind-default work, so they are the best available owner for a proof-acceptance decision on this compatibility-sensitive surface.
